observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A spacious community hall with a wooden floor, chairs lined up against the wall, a stage with a band in the background.
observation.dancers: Two female dancers of different heights, in a teacher-student arrangement.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples formation, dancing side-by-side facing forward, traveling in a small circle around the floor.
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees, weight evenly distributed with bouncy steps.
observation.footwork: Walking and stepping in time with the music; 3 steps forward, turn, 3 steps back, repeat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Initially holding hands with one arm over the shoulder, later transitioning to ballroom hold and side-by-side hand holding.
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal torso movement, gentle turning of the upper body during steps.
observation.partnering: Paired dancing with alternating shoulder hold, hand-in-hand hold, and ballroom hold.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Standing level, turning in place and twirling under arms.
observation.costume_and_props: Tartan skirts, dark stockings, black shoes, short-sleeved dark t-shirts.
observation.cannot_infer: Low resolution makes exact foot positions and weight shifts difficult to distinguish at high speeds.

signature_moments.what: Three steps forward followed by a turn in place, then three steps back.
One dancer twirling underneath the raised arms of the other.
